notes.title: v1.2.0.1 Emergency Fix 🔧
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where screen resolution was not properly adjusted on some devices.

notes.title: AI Upgrade: Enhanced Offense and Defense Evaluation
notes.content:
AI Enhancements  
  
 AI now possesses offensive and defensive capabilities based on situational analysis, enabling accurate decision-making for each turn.  
 Added a danger tile analysis function, making AI more cautious and rational in defense to avoid reckless discards.  
  

Art  
  
 Added the new Black Tile design, which can be freely selected in the "Mahjong Workshop."  
 Added the new Suzhou Tile design, which can be freely selected in the "Mahjong Workshop."  
  

Animation  
  
 Added dynamic effects for kan animations, including Open kan, Added kan, and Closed kan.  
  

Bug Fixes  
  
 Fixed an issue where tiles might turn gray when using a controller or keyboard.  
 Fixed an issue where tile corner numbers would not display correctly during the first game in English mode.  
 Corrected a spelling error on the tenpai panel: "Waitting" => "Waiting."  
 Fixed the incorrect pronunciation of "Second Round" in 【East 2】 and 【South 2】 rounds.  
 Fixed an issue where custom music filenames containing special characters could not load properly.

notes.title: December 20 Update Notes
notes.content:
Mahjong Factory

 Added the "Music" customization feature, allowing players to modify in-game music.
- You can place your local music files in the designated folder, supporting various audio formats.
- Up to 10 music groups can be added, each with a customizable cover image.
- A different music group can be assigned to menus, gameplay, Riichi, and the final round.


Animation

 Added tile movement animations for "Chi" and "Pon" actions.


UI

 Adjusted text styles and several screen backgrounds to make text easier to read.


Art

 Adjusted the designs of the Pinzu and Souzu tiles in the "Black Tiles" style to better harmonize with other designs.
 Adjusted the Pinzu tile design in the "Yellow Bamboo" style to better harmonize with other designs.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where a Ron or Tsumo could not be determined properly during "Double Fan Restriction."
 Fixed an issue where hands were not displayed during a drawn round caused by four-player Riichi.

notes.title: December 5 Update Notes
notes.content:
UI

 Adjusted the text style, position, and backgrounds of several screens to improve readability


Mahjong Factory

 Now, the last switched tab will open automatically by default
 Added the "UI" customization feature, allowing players to customize the UI
- A more compact table layout can be selected (makes tiles in the discard pile larger)
- Adjust visibility of certain table UI elements


Windowed Mode

 Added 2K, 1080p, and 720p resolution options for windowed mode


Art

 Redesigned the visual effect indicating the "current player" on the table for better harmony
 Adjusted the patterns and tile body colors of the "Black Tile" style to be less glaring
 Adjusted the patterns of the "Yellow Bamboo" style bamboo tiles for better harmony


Performance

 Optimized the game's disk space usage


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where some tile patterns could display outside the tile boundaries

notes.title: July 9 Update Notes
notes.content:
Mahjong Factory
Added the "Table" customization feature, allowing players to customize the table

 Choose table style
 Customize table wallpaper
 Adjust wallpaper brightness


Windowed Mode

 When in windowed mode, you can choose from 70%, 60%, and 50% sizes
 When in windowed mode, the window ratio will be restricted between 3:2 and 16:9

notes.title: June 16 Update Notes
notes.content:
Animation

 Fixed the dealer's tile jump animation to ensure they jump to grab two tiles, not consecutively grab two tiles, to better reflect actual Mahjong rules.
 Added an animation effect to the indicator tile for the dora.
 At the end of the dealing phase, the tail corner tiles of the wall will be moved down, to better reflect actual Mahjong play.


Performance

 Optimized the game's disk usage.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the placement of horizontally placed tiles in a Exposed might be incorrect.

notes.title: The customization feature "Mahjong Factory" is now live!
notes.content:
The new customization feature "Mahjong Factory” is now live

Model - Customization

 Choose from several preset Mahjong models
 Choose from several preset colors, or use the HSV slider to freely set a color for the back of the tiles
 Choose from several preset colors, or use the HSV slider to freely set a color for the body of the tiles


Pattern - Customization

 Choose from several preset front tile patterns as the base front tile pattern
 Place custom front tile patterns for some or all Mahjong tiles in the specified directory to replace the base front tile pattern
 Choose from several preset back tile patterns as the back tile pattern
 Place custom back tile patterns in the specified directory to be displayed as the back tile pattern


A new Mahjong style "Customization" has been added, and the appearance of Mahjong tiles set in "Mahjong Factory” will be saved as this style.
You can switch between the "Customization" style and existing styles at any time.

Other Updates

Art

 Significantly improved the clarity of Mahjong tile patterns
 Changed the Mahjong tiles in the "Yellow Bamboo" and "Kanto 1" styles to models with mortise and tenon structure


Game Content

 When dealing and after calling, the rightmost tile will no longer be placed with a gap, to better match the actual situation


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where self-draw (Tsumo) sometimes wouldn't work
 Fixed an issue where "Common Terminals" would also be counted as "Common Ends"
 Fixed an issue where right-clicking often couldn't perform a Tsumo cut

notes.title: May 8th Update Notes
notes.content:
Art

 Add a new Mahjong style: Black
 Adjust colors of UI elements to match various Mahjong styles


Input Devices

 Increase idle time for automatic mouse hiding to 15 seconds, and the mouse is no longer moved to the center of the screen when automatically hidden
 Pressing the left or right mouse button, or the controller's [Confirm/Cancel] button on the winning hand panel will skip the display of point symbols


Game Content

 Increase speed of point movement during point settlement

notes.title: May 1st Update - Additional
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Add appropriate specular highlights to the bamboo styles "Green Bamboo" and "Yellow Bamboo".

notes.title: May 1st Update Notes
notes.content:
Input Devices

 Right-clicking the mouse during discard will quickly draw the last tile


Art

 Adjust mahjong models to be more rounded
 Rename mahjong style "bamboo" to "green bamboo" and adjust its model for a more realistic look
 Add a new mahjong style: Yellow Bamboo
 Add a new mahjong style: Kanto 2
 Fix an issue with some patterns being inverted in the Kanto 1 style
 Adjust the thickness of tiles in the waitting-list to match that of the hand tiles


Bug Fixes

 Fix a bug that caused the animation of placing tiles in the hand to be choppy


Special (Bug Resolution Assistance Request)

 I apologize for the presence of some difficult-to-detect bugs in the game due to the complex nature of mahjong gameplay. Therefore, I have added a game process logging feature to assist in resolving bugs related to mahjong gameplay.
 A log file will be generated in the following directory for each game session
Windows: My Documents/Casual Mahjong/LastGame.log
MacOS：~/Casual Mahjong/LastGame.log
Linux：~/Casual Mahjong/LastGame.log
 If you encounter any bugs during the game, you can stop the game, obtain this file, and send it to my email:
hakureiyoumu@outlook.com

notes.title: April 24th Update Emergency Fix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where newly added Kanto 1 mahjong tile pattern was not displayed correctly in some cases

notes.title: April 24th Update Notes
notes.content:
Game Content

 Add a setting in sidebar to enable single or double-click for discarding
 Add a setting in sidebar to toggle visibility of Dora indicator
 Split options between "Main Settings" and "Sidebar Settings"


Art

 Add a new set of mahjong tile patterns: Kanto 1 (Kanto Large Characters)
 Adjust element size and proportions of bamboo-style tile patterns for better coherence
 Adjust position, color, and thickness of some text to improve readability
 Adjust thickness of player's hand tiles to avoid excessive thickness
 Adjust color of white tile backs to be less glaring


Animation and Effects

 Add a animation effect for dealing tiles


Bug Fixes

 Fix a issue where Dora indicator was not displayed correctly upon winning

notes.title: April 17th Update Notes
notes.content:
Game Content

 Remove transparent tiles used as placeholders in the tile river to better conform to standard mahjong rules
 Add a special display effect to the dora indicator for better visibility


Animation and Effects

 Add a animation effect for discarding the riichi stick
 Adjust the position and initial movement effect of the dice to clearly indicate the position of the current round's dealer
 Adjust the collision model of the dice to match its appearance, making it easier to roll


Sound Effects and Music

 Add a sound effect for discarding the riichi stick
 Adjust the collision sound effects of the dice to sound more natural
 Adjust the sound effects of discarding tiles to avoid overly sharp or almost inaudible sounds


Art

 Adjust the proportions of the default-style mahjong tiles for better harmony


Performance Optimization

 Limited the frame rate to 240 to prevent excessive GPU load and performance waste on high-performance computers, and to suppress noise

notes.title: April 10th Update Notes
notes.content:
Game Content

 Adjusted the animation sequence when drawing and discarding tiles to "discard and then put in the new tile", to better adhere to standard mahjong rules


Art

 Redesigned the default style of mahjong tile patterns to resemble the most common offline mahjong patterns


Keyboard & Gamepad

 When the actions list include "Ron" or "Tsumo", they will be set as the default focus, and pressing the confirm key will immediately declare victory


Small Fix

 The random selection method for the discard sound effects during gameplay has been adjusted to prevent consecutive occurrences of the same sound, for reducing dissonance. 
 The volume of the discard sound effects during gameplay has been randomized to minimize the repetition for reducing dissonance.

notes.title: April 3rd Update Notes
notes.content:
Game Content

 Add animation effects to "discarding tiles" and "selecting tiles to play" to make the actions of drawing and playing tiles clearer and easier to distinguish whether it is a "draw and discard".
 Fine-tuned the duration of various random pauses during drawing and playing tiles to make the game rhythm more natural and smooth, reducing the mechanical feel of the actions.
 Reduced the stay time of the speaking frame when declaring tiles, allowing the action of declaring tiles to be completed more quickly.
 The computer player's hand tiles are arranged in random order before being revealed, to avoid inferring the player's hand tiles based on the positions of discarded and played tiles.


UI

 Fine-tuned the font for sharper and clearer display


Localization

 When playing in English, the character tiles and honor tiles will display a numeric or alphabetic text mark in the upper left corner to help players identify Chinese character tiles.
